metadata.description: Skills for software engineering agents: one plugin per technology, and a delivery process that reads the repository's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: mulesoft
plugins.description: Mule 4 applications, DataWeave, MUnit and the Mule SDK: rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: REST API specifications in RAML and OpenAPI: resources, data types, errors, examples, versioning and security, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: java
plugins.description: Standalone Java: the build and JDK a project declares, dependencies, nulls, exceptions and JUnit tests, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Python applications, CLIs and scripts with logic: locked dependencies, environments, safe paths, encodings and pytest tests, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: shell
plugins.description: Bash and POSIX sh scripts, git hooks and pipeline steps: strict mode, quoting, guarded destructive commands and portability, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: azure-devops
plugins.description: Azure Pipelines YAML: templates and pinned refs, variable groups, environments and approvals, secrets and release triggers, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: GitHub Actions workflows: pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, untrusted input, secrets and environments, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: jenkins
plugins.description: Jenkinsfiles and Groovy shared libraries: declarative pipelines, failure handling, credentials and parameters in sh steps, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: astro
plugins.description: Astro static sites: clean builds and astro check, .astro markup pitfalls, content schema helpers, public URLs and redirects, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare Workers and Pages: wrangler config, routes, webhook signatures, secrets, staging and production deploys and rollbacks, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: A change flow for any code repository: entry and exit checklists, independent review, merge gates by risk and delivery models, driven by lines of the repository's AGENTS.md.
